critical_code_review_comments: booking_controller.py still 4807 lines — again recommend splitting (tip + reviews are now additional surfaces that would fit a booking/finance.py and booking/reviews.py module).

add_tip order-of-ops: booking.tip is claimed BEFORE the wallet debit; if the debit fails the tip is rolled back via $unset — this is safe but there is a tiny race window where a concurrent reader could see the booking as tipped before the debit completes. The pending-reviews endpoint only shows tip_amount so impact is cosmetic; still, consider wallet-debit-first-then-tip-claim for strict consistency, or wrap in a Mongo transaction if the deployment uses a replica set.

add_tip's atomic claim uses `{tip:None}` OR `{tip:{$exists:false}}` OR `{tip.amount:{$in:[0,None]}}` — the third branch is actually dead code because tip_precheck already rejects any booking with tip.amount set; harmless but misleading.

payment_controller._apply('tip') passes b.pay_tip_amount into booking_controller.add_tip which re-runs tip_precheck — if the user's wallet state or booking status changed between create_order and _apply, the online-paid tip could be rejected AFTER money was captured. Not reachable in the happy path (gateway webhook arrives in ms), but there is no refund-on-fail path for an online tip that fails tip_precheck at apply-time. Consider: either skip tip_precheck in the 'online' re-apply (money already captured) or trigger an auto-refund.

pending_reviews returns partner_photo='' silently when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env is not set on the backend process. Backend deployment MUST ensure this env is set (it was NOT set in the preview container during this test run), otherwise the thank-you card falls back to the initial-letter avatar across all customers. Recommend adding a startup check or logging a warning when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing at import time.
RateService.jsx line 229 fetches /wallet unconditionally on every booking.id change — fine for one booking but inefficient if the component re-mounts; cache ok as-is.

success_rate.frontend: static review only — all required testIDs/hooks/branches present
